skill.name: troubleshooting-motoko-migrations
skill.description: Troubleshoot Motoko migration diagnostics, frozen migration files, legacy conversion baselines, and unsupported persistence downgrades using a focused reference.
skill.summary: Diagnose mops-managed migration failures while preserving deployed history and live canister state.
skill.author: caffeinelabs

security_audit.summary: All 37 static findings are false positives: 35 match Markdown backticks, and two misclassify canister installation diagnostics as system reconnaissance. The reference discourages permission bypasses, migration history rewrites, and unsafe configuration changes. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential collection, exfiltration, or malicious execution.

content.value_statement: Motoko migration errors can conflict with current source code and put deployed state at risk. This reference explains diagnostics and forward-only repairs while preserving migration history.
actual_capabilities: Explain migration replay differences between upgrades and fresh canister installs.
Map compiler and runtime diagnostics to likely migration problems and repair approaches.
Explain why frozen or applied migration files must not be edited, renamed, or deleted.
Interpret non-empty conversion baselines and inherited legacy migration history.
Explain protected migration configuration, pending migration limits, and unsupported persistence downgrades.
Identify chain growth risks and explain why successful build checks do not guarantee installation.
limitations: Provides a troubleshooting reference, not executable scripts or an automated repair tool.
Routine migration authoring is delegated to the related migrating-motoko-actors skill, which is not bundled here.
Diagnosis depends on project configuration, migration files, diagnostics, and deployed stable signatures supplied by the user or environment.
Targets moc 1.11.2 or later and mops core 2.5.0 or later; platform-owned limits require platform support.

use_cases.title: Explain Unexpected Compatibility Errors
use_cases.description: Trace checker fields absent from current source to the deployed stable signature and identify the appropriate pending migration changes.

use_cases.title: Review a Converted Project Baseline
use_cases.description: Review a non-empty first migration baseline and preserve legacy state when maintaining a converted or forked project.
use_cases.target_user: Maintainer of a converted or forked canister

use_cases.title: Investigate Installation Failures
use_cases.description: Assess IC0505 installation errors, chain growth, and protected configuration without bypassing platform controls.

prompt_templates.title: Understand a Diagnostic
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain this Motoko migration diagnostic: [diagnostic]. Identify likely causes, needed evidence, and safe next steps without changing files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: interpret a compiler or runtime error.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Frozen Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: A write failed on this migration: [filename]. Review [deployment history] and [requested state change]. Distinguish pending from applied changes and propose a forward-only repair.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: respond to a read-only migration file.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Legacy Conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [first migration], [current actor declarations], and [deployed stable signature] for a converted project. Explain the baseline and flag assumptions before proposing changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: investigate inherited or converted migration history.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Chain Mismatch
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [diagnostics], [migration chain], [mops configuration], and [deployed stable signature]. Assess history consistency and installation risks. Preserve protected configuration and produce an escalation report for unresolved mismatches.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: diagnose interacting deployment and history failures.

output_examples.input: A write to an applied migration failed while adding a stable field.
output: The read-only file represents deployed history and must remain unchanged.
Express the field addition in a new migration that transforms the current state.
Confirm the new migration supplies the field before deployment.

output_examples.input: The first migration in a converted project has a non-empty OldActor.
output: A non-empty baseline is expected when state predates the enhanced migration chain.
Preserve the conversion baseline and existing values rather than replacing them with an empty state.
Compare the baseline with the deployed stable signature if diagnostics remain unexplained.

output_examples.input: The build and checker pass, but installation fails with IC0505 on a long migration chain.
output: The diagnostic may indicate that stable-type history exceeds the platform custom-section limit.
Successful build checks alone do not establish that the artifact can be installed.
Stop adding migrations and report the platform limit rather than deleting history or retrying the same artifact.

best_practices: Compare diagnostics with the deployed stable signature, not only local source or version history.
Preserve applied migration identities and consolidate related unapplied changes into one pending migration.
Keep actor bodies static and stable types lean; escalate unexplained signature mismatches before deployment.
anti_patterns: Editing, renaming, deleting, or changing permissions on frozen applied migrations to bypass a failure.
Replacing a converted baseline with empty state or reseeding fields that contain live data.
Relaxing protected configuration, removing the chain, or treating successful build checks as proof of installability.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for unexplained migration diagnostics, frozen files, converted baselines, or requests to remove the migration chain.

faq.question: Does it automatically repair or deploy a canister?
faq.answer: No. It provides reference guidance and diagnostic reasoning, not bundled repair scripts or deployment automation.

faq.question: Why does the checker mention fields absent from current source?
faq.answer: The checker compares against the deployed stable signature, which can contain fields from an earlier version.

faq.question: Can I edit an already-applied migration?
faq.answer: No. Applied migrations are tracked by module name and skipped on later upgrades. Express further changes through a new migration.

faq.question: Can an enhanced migration project return to legacy persistence?
faq.answer: The reference describes no supported downgrade path. Preserve the chain and use a forward-only migration to achieve the requested state changes.

faq.question: Does a successful build and check guarantee installation?
faq.answer: No. Chain history can exceed installation limits even when builds and checks pass. Investigate IC0505 and escalate platform limits.
